title: sudo_grant v1
description: One subject of a sudoers user specification, with aliases expanded but groups not resolved: the engine resolves groups and UIDs against the identity and group facts. Emitted before the sudoers_snapshot of the same run_id. Negated subjects grant nothing and are not emitted.

subject_kind.description: user: a login name; group: %group; uid: #uid; gid: %#gid.

subject.description: The name or number, without % or #.

nopasswd.description: The specification carries a NOPASSWD tag.
